span.p:
Two PoE cameras
[polarising, infrared, fixed mount]
one still each every 15 min

div.style: color: rgb(74, 13, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Splash sensor
[LoRaWAN]
surface break outside feeding

div.style: color: rgb(4, 52, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Preprocess
[code on the GPU box]
crop, deglare, discard frames
with a keeper or net in view

div.style: color: rgb(4, 52, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Counting model
[small tuned model, GPU box]
detector if spread, density map if tight

div.style: color: rgb(4, 52, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Burst maximum, then smoothing
[service]
higher of two cameras,
median of the last two hours

span.p:
Population estimator
[Bayesian state space model]
learns the camera undercount
from the manual counts

never a bare number

span.p:

against food per fish
